title: Standard Cleaning
summary: A reliable weekly, biweekly, or monthly refresh for a consistently clean home.
description: Ideal for maintained homes that need routine dusting, kitchens, bathrooms, floors, and touch-point cleaning.
includes: Clean kitchen counters, sink, stovetop, and appliance exteriors
Empty trash and tidy common areas

faqs.question: Can I set recurring visits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Weekly, biweekly, and monthly plans are available with recurring discounts.

title: Deep Cleaning
summary: A detailed reset for homes that need extra care from top to bottom.
description: Best for first-time clients, seasonal resets, post-event cleanup, and homes needing detailed attention.
includes: Detailed dusting including baseboards and door frames
Scrub showers, tubs, tile, and grout touch-ups
Vacuum edges and mop hard floors

faqs.question: Should I book a deep clean first?
faqs.answer: A deep clean is recommended for first visits so recurring maintenance starts from a refreshed baseline.

title: Move-In / Move-Out
summary: A focused empty-home cleaning for transitions, landlords, sellers, and renters.
description: Designed for vacant or mostly vacant spaces, with extra attention to cabinets, appliances, closets, and bathrooms.
includes: Clean inside empty cabinets and drawers

faqs.question: Do utilities need to be active?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water and electricity must be available for the best results.

title: Eco-Friendly Cleaning
summary: A gentler clean using family-conscious, low-fragrance product options.
description: Great for households that prefer mindful products, pet-friendly options, and a softer scent profile.

faqs.question: Can I provide my own products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mia’s team can use approved client-provided products when instructions are clear.
